LandscapeService.batch_line_trace:
X.batch_line_trace(start_locations, end_locations) -> Array[LineTraceHit]
Perform multiple line traces in a single call.
Maps to action="batch_line_trace"

Args:
    start_locations (Array[Vector]): Array of trace start points
    end_locations (Array[Vector]): Array of trace end points (must match length)

Returns:
    Array[LineTraceHit]: Array of hit results, same length as input arrays
LandscapeService.batch_line_trace_grid:
X.batch_line_trace_grid(origin_x, origin_y, width, height, grid_resolution=10, start_z=100000.000000, end_z=-100000.000000) -> Array[LineTraceHit]
Perform a grid of downward line traces over a world-space region.
Maps to action="batch_line_trace_grid"

Args:
    origin_x (float): World X of grid start corner
    origin_y (float): World Y of grid start corner
    width (float): Grid width in world units
    height (float): Grid height in world units
    grid_resolution (int32): Number of sample points per axis
    start_z (float): Trace start Z (above terrain)
    end_z (float): Trace end Z (below terrain)

Returns:
    Array[LineTraceHit]: Row-major array of hit results (GridResolution x GridResolution)

SystemLibrary.line_trace_multi_by_profile:
X.line_trace_multi_by_profile(world_context_object, start, end, profile_name, trace_complex, actors_to_ignore, draw_debug_type, ignore_self=True, trace_color=[1.000000, 0.000000, 0.000000, 1.000000], trace_hit_color=[0.000000, 1.000000, 0.000000, 1.000000], draw_time=5.000000) -> Array[HitResult] or None
Trace a ray against the world using a specific profile and return overlapping hits and then first blocking hit
Results are sorted, so a blocking hit (if found) will be the last element of the array
Only the single closest blocking result will be generated, no tests will be done after that

Args:
    world_context_object (Object): 
    start (Vector): Start of line segment.
    end (Vector): End of line segment.
    profile_name (Name): The 'profile' used to determine which components to hit
    trace_complex (bool): True to test against complex collision, false to test against simplified collision.
    actors_to_ignore (Array[Actor]): 
    draw_debug_type (DrawDebugTrace): 
    ignore_self (bool): 
    trace_color (LinearColor): 
    trace_hit_color (LinearColor): 
    draw_time (float): 

Returns:
    Array[HitResult] or None: True if there was a blocking hit, false otherwise.

    out_hits (Array[HitResult]):
